steps: Music lane: m1 at 2 with length 2.0004; m2 at 10.4 with length 2.6; 40 px/s; Snap on 1 s
Drag m1's header in samples of +160/+200/+230/+254 px (raw 8.35)
bugs.expected: m1's end touches m2 (start ~8.3996), as the control with length exactly 2 does (P1c lands at 8.4)
bugs.actual: m1 stays at 8 and the status shows 'გადატანა დაბლოკილია — მეზობელი კლიპი ან დროის დასაწყისი. კლიპი ბოლო თავისუფალ ადგილას დარჩა.' Edges and lengths are rounded to whole ms and the rounded candidate is returned, so the real end overlaps by up to 0.5 ms and moveClip (EPS 1e-4) refuses it. Start-touch after a neighbour ending at 6.0004 (P1s) is also refused; stage 1 would refuse it too (grid 6 overlaps), but the edge candidate is rounded to 6.0 and does not rescue it. Library drops store the raw buffer.duration, so real decoded or purchased audio is affected; the synthetic demo SFX are whole seconds, which hides this on L52. Trim path not probed at runtime; by code reading the trim clamps to the exact neighbour start and TRIM_BLOCK_TOLERANCE=0.01 exceeds the 0.5 ms difference (unverified).
